No, to discard it entirely.''|Muyu, [[Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled]]}} '''Muyu''' {{Lang|zh=木禺}}, also known as '''Master Shenyuan''', is a quest-exclusive NPC who makes his first appearance as the main antagonist in [[Version 3.5]] during the {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}} and [[Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled|''Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled'']] in [[Chapter IV]]: Act II. He returns as the main antagonist in [[Version/3.6|Version 3.6]] during the [[Main Quest]] [[Song of the Heart Sword|''Song of the Heart Sword'']] in [[Chapter IV]]: Act III and ultimately meets his end shortly before the events of [[Jingran]]'s Segue, [[The Nethermancer's Requiem|''The Nethermancer's Requiem'']]. ==Profile== He is a former helmsman of [[Zhuojun Atelier]]'s Jianshui Branch and the Xuanfang [[Ministry of Development]] that came to doubt humanity's trust in the Sentinels over 200 years ago after becoming misanthropic during the Fortress and Gorges War, believing that humanity should act to protect themselves and progress through their own merits and ingenuity. In modern times, he now seeks to expose the Sentinels' vulnerabilities by instigating [[Xuanfang|Xuanfang Hold]]'s Autopuppet Crisis, by unleashing Autopuppets possessed by the lingering Reverberations of fallen soldiers from the Fortress and Gorges War who still held contempt for the [[Tacet Discord]]s that felled them, which he altered to hold negative emotions towards humanity instead.{{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}} ==Story== ===History=== Over 200 years ago prior to the Fortress and Gorges War, Muyu was one of the engineers of Zhoujun Atelier who constructed [[Yuan Fortress]]. Following the war's traumatic conclusion and the self-destruction of Yuan Fortress, Muyu grew disillusioned with Hsin, scorning her for her perceived abandonment of Xuanfang's people to [[Ovathrax]]'s mass destruction as the war raged and took countless lives, which drove him insane. He was cut out of the restoration effort by Hsin alongside the rest of Zhoujun Atelier, with them being replaced by the [[Court of Savantae]]'s engineer staff to lead Xuanfang Hold's construction. Well over a century later, over 20 years prior to the current story, Muyu publicly announced his departure from [[Zhuojun Atelier]] and rebuked the organization, despite being chosen by the [[Flowerveil Puppet]] to be the next Grand Helm. Later, prior to the Autopuppet crisis, Muyu met and formed a tentative alliance of convenience with [[Balanophora]], the [[Fractsidus]] overseer responsible for assassinating the original [[Hsin]], due to their overall shared goals of sabotaging [[Hsin]]. Muyu also temporarily partnered with [[Jingran]], who, unbeknownst to him, had infiltrated the Zhoujun Atelier in order to get to Muyu after learning he was responsible for the murder of his parents over 15 years prior, who were killed by rogue Bladepuppets that Muyu corrupted. Jingran feigned working as a supply runner for Muyu while posing as his contact within the Zhoujun Atelier in the lead-up to the Autopuppet Crisis.{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} A Damaged Communication Log: :'''[[Balanophora|Gentle Female Voice:]]''' As you requested, ████ has fallen into isolation. :'''Gentle Female Voice:''' Nothing stands between you and your plans now, but don't forget our agreement. :'''Stern Male Voice:''' Sure, ████ is yours. :'''Stern Male Voice:''' But only after I've obtained the ██ inside of it. :'''Gentle Female Voice:''' Very well, I'll be waiting. :'''Gentle Female Voice:''' So it seems... you are no different from the [[Court of Savantae]] after all. ===The Autopuppet Crisis=== Muyu orchestrated the Autopuppet crisis in Xuanfang from behind the scenes, initially corrupting Autopuppets into attacking residents by possessing them with emotionally distorted Reverberations stemming from souls lost to the [[Fortress and Gorges War]] that he had amassed for years. After a serious of continual losses involving his failure to tempt [[Yangyang]] over to his side to use her power, and loss of the [[Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis|Myriad Snare]] at the Skyworks factory to [[Rover]]'s intervention, he forcefully launched a massive invasion of [[Xuanfang Hold]]. However, the invasion was stopped by a crucial coordination of [[Qingxiao]]'s defense of the Hold's perimeter and the destruction of Muyu's [[Thousand-Puppet Pavilion]] within a Censure Court. Despite wielding furious power, however, the massive Autopuppet was defeated by Rover with the aid of the Yangyang's mysterious second awakening- triggered by an inexplicable resonance with the [[Xuanling Bird]]. Seemingly trapped and forced to fend for his life, his presence was exposed as a puppet decoy after having its arm amputated by [[Yangyang]]'s blade. The decoy promptly self-destructed and caused the duo to fall into the depths of the Censure Court, as Muyu used the chaos as a smokescreen to flee and regroup with [[Jingran]]. ===The Infiltration of Xuanyuan Domain=== In the weeks following the invasion of Xuanfang Hold, the two left to seek out Hsin's trail in the [[Fogveil Pagoda]], where Jingran secretly left a Resonance-charged pendant behind for Rover to eventually find and use to open a way into the Xuanyuan Domain. Muyu later orchestrated a takeover of the Xuanyuan Domain's internal Sonoro Sphere, restoring an ancient blueprint of the Cloud Shuttle fleet left within its records by Hsin, while posing as a Ministry of Development engineer to its denizens under the pretense of being a revolutionary engineer who had reinvigorated the Yuan Fortress of old into a technological utopia for Xuanfang. He secretly used the residents to continue his experiments, gradually eroding the emotions of the Cloud Shuttle staff and engineers onboard to render them dull, stoic, and anhedonic to embody his vision of a technocratic humanity driven by pure rationalist logic. He also continued his experiments with Reverberation-possessed Autopuppets, opting instead to use docile Reverberations of the deceased in place of the hostile Reverberations he used prior. Eventually, Muyu started to use the Sanctum's mainframe controls to begin breaking down the Censure Courts, leading to Xuanfang Hold being brought to the brink of destruction by waves of Tacet Discords he unleashed. ===Pursued by Rover and Qingxiao=== Rover and Qingxiao came to ally after running into one another on Muyu's trail in Fogveil Pagoda in the midst of the Tacet Discord outbreak, where Rover later used the pendant to bypass the Sanctum's security lock by traveling through a [[Sonoro Sphere|Mirage Realm]] into it, where they were ambushed inside by Jingran and a projection of Muyu, who had left Jingran behind to stand guard. After a brief clash between Rover and Jingran, the two goaded them into following before fleeing. Following their arrival at the Sanctum's control mainframe further inside, Hsin remotely triggered the Prism of Fate, causing the Sanctum to violently transform and whisk the duo into the Xuanyuan Domain through a rift. They traversed through the realms of the Domain from the ground-up, navigating through each of its three levels, the Ren, Di, and Tian realms. Jingran eventually chose to blow his cover once Rover and Qingxiao had made enough progress through the Xuanyuan Domain's Di Realm, finally betraying Muyu by backstabbing him as he monologued to Rover and Qingxiao through a projection, who quickly fled to steal a Cloud Shuttle to escape. After being pursued into his lair within the Xuanyuan Domain's Tian Realm by [[Rover]], [[Qingxiao]], and [[Jingran]], Muyu revealed he had separated his own reverberation from his own physical body, intending to mimic Hsin's [[Celestial]]s by existing in spirit as a living frequency that inhabited an Autopuppet shell he created, the [[Calamity Effigy]], seeking to transcend through a machine apotheosis. In a tense final battle between he, Rover, and Qingxiao, Muyu's shell was brought to its knees. Bitter and refusing to concede his regrets, Muyu spitefully clung to his ambitions in his final words to the duo, maintaining that he accepted the consequences of his work, and that any regrets would sully his efforts by dishonoring the "materials" he exploited to reach the Domain. He revealed to Rover that it had been the [[Fractsidus]] who actually sought out the civilization capsule in response to Rover's assumption he acted alone, exposing [[Balanophora]] and her role in his conspiracy. Unrepentant to the end, his final words to the duo were spent mocking their efforts, balking at how Xuanfang Hold's destruction was inevitable, and that he had never once concealed his true ambitions from them in spite of his "madness", before being destroyed.{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} ===Defeat=== Unbeknownst to the two, Muyu survived the encounter, having secretly transferred his Reverberation once more into a frail, small serpentine Autopuppet shell outside of the Xuanyuan Domain. While attempting to make his way towards a data-core of Hsin's nestled in the Garden of Seasons, Muyu was stopped and confronted by [[Jingran]] and [[Qiuyuan]], who had been working with Jingran to also track Muyu's whereabouts. In a failed plea for his life, Muyu's attempts to convince Jingran to restart their partnership were met with scorn, with Jingran revealing to Muyu that he killed his parents 10-15 years prior, and that he sought revenge for their unjust deaths. Cornered at his wits' end and without any more allies, nor any escape, Muyu was executed by Jingran on the spot after learning the truth of his identity, avenging his parents at long last, along with countless others victimized by him across [[Mengzhou]] and Xuanfang. ==Appearance== Muyu was a tall and slim man of pale skin with sharp and angular features. He has short black hair with white streaks in the front, a short goatée, narrow eyes that is grey in the left side and red in the right. His [[Tacet Mark]] is located on his right forearm. ===Clothing=== He wears a white tanfu with greyish-blue outlines kept in golden holders with a green gem on it under a dark green long-sleeved jacket guided by red earrings kept in the shoulders kept by black belts with a golden buckles and teal collars with white lines. The jacket also features a badge with a certification card of him. As well dark green pants with a belt that that features various golden fleur-de-lisses on it that holds a black book, a dark green holder styled in Chinese art in the back as well black gloves and shoes. ===[[Calamity Effigy]]=== After transferring his own conscious into an [[Auto Handpuppet|Autopuppet]] to become a self-proclaimed Celestial, Muyu became a much larger and slightly muscular version of himself with long black hair that has glowing light green streaks in the front, known as the [[Calamity Effigy]]. In place of his face is a featureless white mask with black markings, along with dark green and black metallic skin plating with a large Tacet Mark in the chest. He wears nothing, save for a cloak that glows in white, alongside light green outlines that covers the rest of his body, which is held up like a clothesline by a light purple fabric that floats. He wears long pants of the same color as the skin, tied by black ropes that hold grape-shaped glowing light green earrings. ==Personality== Shown by his belief in the Sentinels actions as "absurd delusions", Muyu was a sadistic man that was obsessed with seeing his century-long grand design to its conclusion. He was a hyper-rationalist that believed humanity's anger and collective emotion to be a collective burden that held back their full potential, while also presenting a facade of honorability towards those he attempted to use, as seen with his joyful praising of [[Yangyang]]'s fighting skills. He possesseed a vast superiority complex, believing himself and his design to be above the comprehension of the common populace, and even extended this to the likes of the [[Fractsidus]], who he believed to be "lawless fanatics" that were a simple means to an end for his use in their partnership. He also showcased a degree of anthropocentrism during his initial clash with [[Rover]] at the Skyworks, through how he scornfully dismissed Rover's humanity as an attempt at "pretending" to be human. Muyu was also a cold and calculating pragmatist who abstained from taking personal risk and preferred to keep his distance when realizing his plans, as shown when his apparent presence during his attack on Xuanfang Hold turned out to be a puppet decoy that masqueraded as him throughout the attack. This was also shown most maliciously in how he carefully orchestrated the Autopuppet frenzy as a false flag attack, intending to frame [[Hsin]] for the violence committed by the rogue Autopuppets to instill societal doubts in her guidance and motives. In his final moments, Muyu was shown to be unrepentant in his ambitions, clinging to a facade of confidence and strength. Unapologetic and refusing to admit any regret about his failure, he sharply mocked Rover and Qingxiao with a sadistic glee in his view that Xuanfang's people would inevitably be destroyed despite the dismantling of his agenda. However, this facade crumbled once Muyu's Reverberation was forced into a much more pathetic Autopuppet shell, as he somberly attempted to assure himself that his journey was not a failure while en route to Hsin's data core in the Garden of Seasons. Quickly stopped in the face of his soon-to-be killer and former partner, Jingran, Muyu's vulnerabilities, hypocrisy, and desperation were pitifully brought to light. He pleaded for his life by offering the core and its secrets to Jingran to no avail, as his last words were spent envisioning how his vision would have created a "perfect" humanity, dying as a hollow man that remained forever faithful in his technocratic ideals to the very end. ==Abilities== Muyu was an incredibly intelligent and capable man. Despite his willingness to cause harm, much of what he achieved came from proper planning, preparations, and years of improving his own techniques and learning as much as he could. As a prodigy of Automata Mechanics, Suisui's research reveals how he created Yuan Fortress and was capable enough to be the next Grand Helm. After the [[Fortress and Gorges War]], alongside awakening his Fortre, Muyu would continuously experiment and refine his abilities for two centuries. He was also capable in his preparations to endanger all of Xuanfang Hold with minimal help, beyond the small aid he required from the Fractsidus and his former [[Zhuojun Atelier]] branch. ===Resonance=== While the exact details of his Forte are unconfirmed, after the Fortress and Gorges War, Muyu awakened as a [[Resonator]] and gained the ability to capture and harvest the Reverberations of the deceased. Spending two centuries on these experiments allowed him to find ways to influence, manipulate, fuse, and control the Reverberations he harvested with seemingly no limit in how many he could contain within his Tacet Mark. In particular, he managed to discover a method in corrupting Sentinel Hsin's Autopuppets by merging the Reverberations into their cores. He also used his influence on them to alter the Reverberations' perspectives, guiding and redirecting their hatred towards humanity rather than Tacet Discords. While the Reverberations under his influence were capable of being self-aware enough to understand their situation, only through Yangyang's Resonance Ability were they properly freed. By the events of [[Song of the Heart Sword]], Muyu's experiments granted him further control over Reverberations and their control over Autopuppets. In particular, as he told Jingran, after proving how Reverberations can influence an Autopuppet's logic behavior, he discovered the ability to have Reverberations control the Autopuppet shell itself, while also scrubbing away their redundant emotions to ensure they couldn't feel the desire for revenge against him. While this made them loyal followers, there were still some who kept their self-awareness and hid away from him. One of his goals were to ensure that alongside ridding the Reverberations of their emotions, he could make them immortal by perfectly fusing them with the Autopuppet shells so that they would never truly die. He also learned that by harvesting their negative emotions, Muyu could cripple and cause numerous anomalies across Xuanfang Hold's mainframe systems within the Sanctum, threatening the entire location in his attempt to discover the secrets within. ====Body Modifications==== During the events of [[The Wind Before the Storm]], he revealed to Yangyang that he modified his right eye after losing it. This allowed him to see a person's frequencies directly and analyze them, as he did to Yangyang when he believed her reverberation could be a key component to his plans. ====Puppet Creation==== [[Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled]] revealed that he was capable enough to create a puppet body that was so lifelike, it was virtually indistinguishable from his true body. This allowed him to deploy the body out on the field to avoid actual confrontation, while still gathering information from the puppet body. The puppet body could even defend itself from Rover's attack via a powerful barrier. If the puppet body became critically damaged, as it did at the end of [[Rover]] and Yangyang's battle against it during Muyu's assault on Xuanfang Hold, it could trigger a catastrophically explosive self-destruct sequence. ====Longevity==== After becoming a Resonator, Muyu gained immensely increased physical longevity, managing to live for over 200 years while retaining his youthful appearance. Suisui noted that this was exceptionally long, even for Resonator standards. ====Reverberation Transference==== Muyu eventually gained enough knowledge to discover a way to transfer his Reverberation into Autopuppet shells, as he did when he transferred his Reverberation into the [[Calamity Effigy]] vessel, and later on, a much smaller serpentine shell in an attempt to escape and steal one of Hsin's data cores in the Garden of Seasons. ====Abilities as Calamity Effigy==== As the Calamity Effigy, alongside his prior abilities, Muyu gained additional powers. The shell granted him immense superhuman strength, durability, reflexes, and came with two additional arms. Due to this, it allowed him to keep up and fight on par with [[Rover]] and [[Qingxiao]] at once in a heated battle, before eventually being overwhelmed. These abilities included levitation, short-range teleportation, weapon materialization with launched projectiles, and increased the speed of his Reverberation absorption ability. When defeated the first time, he could also recover from the damage he took from Rover and Qingxiao for a second chance at resuming the battle, and was also accompanied by two mechanical Autopuppets that aided him in battle. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Gallery== File:NPC Muyu Full Body.png|Full Body File:NPC Calamity Effigy.png|Muyu as the [[Calamity Effigy]] File:NPC Muyu Autopuppet.png|Muyu's final Autopuppet shell ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Muyu |zhs = 木禺 |zht = 木禺 |ja = 木禺 |ko = 목우 |es = Muyu |fr = Muyu |de = Muyu |th = Muyu |pt = Muyu }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.5}} ==References== {{Reflist}} [[zh:木禺]]
